brief: A high-performance desktop application built in Rust + GPUI that scans, categorizes, and organizes cluttered Downloads. Features instant SHA-256 deduplication, 90+ day old file warnings, and safe Trash removal with Undo.
criteria: Unmistakable identity, readable down to 16px in system taskbar/dock, conveys sorting and downward flow, fits the warm dark UI aesthetic.

concepts.name: Arrow D
concepts.idea: A monolithic geometric capital 'D' with a sharp downward sorting arrow carved into its central counter space.
rationale: Instantly communicates the brand initial 'D' for DownSort
The negative space arrow embodies the core utility: downloads falling into an organized structure
Rock-solid geometry with 100/100 production audit score, scaling effortlessly down to 16px
Harmonizes with the warm dark theme and amber accents of the application

recommendation: Arrow D — the definitive identity for DownSort. Perfect balance between typography, metaphor, and iconographic simplicity.
next_steps: Logo kit finalized with full vector masters, PNG ladders, and icon sets
Embed master app icon into the DownSort GPUI desktop application bundle
Publish brand guidelines for documentation and release distribution
